The following events took place in '''3647 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Notable events==
*The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mnah Ra'at]] begins his [[Sith training]] at the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odacer-Faustin]].<ref name="Red Harvest5" />
*Construction of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] comes to an end.<ref name="Codex Temple">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jedi Temple (Tython)}}</ref>
